addSupplierDescription: Register a new supplier to source products from.
quantityAtLeastOneField: Enter a quantity for at least one field
productCannotBeChanged: The product on a movement can't be changed.
saleOriginWarning: This movement was auto-generated from a sale. Correcting it here won't update the original invoice.
filterChangeOriginWarning: This movement was auto-generated from a completed filter-change schedule job. Correcting it here won't update the original schedule entry.
clearIncorrectRemoval: Set to 0 to clear an incorrect removal.
positiveAddsNegativeSubtracts: Positive adds to that bucket, negative subtracts.
pageDescription: Track stock levels, pricing and suppliers.
deleteProductDescription: This will permanently remove {name} from inventory.
inAndOutDescription: Stock added and removed by date, drawn automatically from the stock movement ledger. Select a date to see the individual entries.

deleteMovementFilterChangeDescription: This movement was auto-generated from a completed filter-change schedule job. Deleting it will adjust {product}'s stock but won't change the original schedule entry.
deleteMovementGenericDescription: This will permanently remove this movement and adjust {product}'s stock accordingly.
noMovementsForDate: No inventory movements for this date.
pendingApprovalDescription: Stock movements auto-created from a completed schedule job's recorded filter items wait here for admin approval — nothing changes in inventory until approved.
nothingPendingApproval: Nothing is waiting on inventory approval right now.
